#version 460
#extension GL_NV_cooperative_vector : require
#extension GL_EXT_shader_explicit_arithmetic_types_float16 : require
#extension GL_EXT_shader_16bit_storage : require
layout(local_size_x=1) in; layout(set=0,binding=0,std430) buffer Output { int data[]; };
void main() { coopvecNV<int,4> a=coopvecNV<int,4>(int(1)); coopVecReduceSumAccumulateNV(a,data,0u); }
